title: Tabular Exchange Conversion Policy
description: Structural shape of a conversion policy document, wire format tabular-exchange.policy/0. Structural validation is necessary and not sufficient: see semantic-validation.md in this directory for the rules this schema cannot express.

format.description: Document kind and wire-format revision. A reader checks this member before any other.

exact_numbers.description: How integer and decimal columns are represented in a destination that has a native numeric form. Applies to every such column of the conversion.

quantize.description: Decimal columns to re-express at another scale. At most one entry per column; the uniqueness rule is semantic.

column.description: Identifier of a decimal column of the schema the policy is used with.

scale.description: Target scale. Must not exceed the declared precision of the column; that rule is semantic.

extensions.description: Settings defined by an implementation or a destination profile, keyed by namespace. A reader refuses a policy that carries a namespace it does not implement. Bounded: at most 8 namespaces, strings of at most 256 code points, unsigned integers up to 9007199254740991, and content no deeper than depth 6 of the document. The bound of 256 values in total is semantic. The content of each namespace is otherwise defined by its owner.

extensionNamespace.description: The object a namespace owns, at depth 3 of the document.

extensionValue4.description: A value at depth 4 of the document.

extensionValue5.description: A value at depth 5 of the document.

extensionValue6.description: A value at depth 6 of the document.

extensionScalar.description: A value under extensions that is not an object or an array.
